title: The Bloody Boot
text: A boot lies in the mud, a Scion's boot, with your House's stitching on the cuff. The lace is still tied. The foot is not in it, and the mud around it is churned with tracks that are not human, all leading away.

options.label: The sharpest eye reads the churned mud, hoping for a sign of life.

outcomes.text: Under the beast-tracks, barefoot ones, limping. Alive. For now, at least.

options.label: Carry the boot along, in case its owner needs it again.

outcomes.text: A small, heavy hope in the pack, and nobody says aloud what everyone is thinking.

options.label: The Leader fears the worst, and hurries after them without caution.

outcomes.text: Faster, and careless, and something in the trees was hoping you would be.
